# Build With Her Media

> Media, systems and AI for women who own businesses. Every visitor gets a Findability Score out of 100, then one clear next step: a free clarity call, a paid strategy consult, an automation build, or a podcast recording.

Operated by BUILD WITH HER MEDIA LLC. Contact: hello@buildwithhermedia.com

## What the Findability Score measures
The SCALE rubric, five areas out of 100 points: Source (25), Clarity (20), Attract (25), Land (15), Elevate (15). Score bands: under 40 Undiscoverable, 40 to 54 Invisible with a pulse, 55 to 69 Leaky, 70 to 84 Solid, 85 to 100 Compounding.

## Pages
- /: home, what the score is and the three ways in
- /score: framing for the Findability Score before the quiz starts
- /score/quiz: the free Findability Score quiz
- /services: ways to work with us — clarity call, strategy consult, automation build, bootcamp, podcast, custom work
- /podcast: the podcast, published guest interviews, its formats, and how to be a guest
- /podcast/book: book a podcast guest slot directly, no sign-in or score required
- /podcast/apply: apply to be a podcast guest
- /learn: the SCALE framework, one article per step, plus everything else we have written (formerly /blog)
- /about: who runs Build With Her Media and our mission (formerly /mission)
- /community: the community
- /events: upcoming and past events
- /contact: how to reach us
- /login: sign in with Google
- /terms: terms of service
- /privacy: privacy notice

## Pricing
Prices are shown on the site only to signed-in clients. Everyone else — including a signed-in lead who has taken the score but not yet paid for anything — sees "shared on your free Clarity Call" instead of a number. The Clarity Call itself is always free.
